result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback 90-day period for Deliverables and preserves the repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies. However, it does not provide an express 30-day Services warranty period, compliance-with-laws warranty, or no-malicious-code warranty. In addition, stating that Section 19.2 does not limit Section 19.1 leaves Section 19.1’s Deliverable conformity warranty without a clear duration, potentially making it broader than the playbook and creating ambiguity with the 90-day period. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
